summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a roughly 100x range, from budget models like GPT-4o mini and Claude Haiku (sub-dollar per million tokens) to premium reasoning models like GPT-4-class and Claude Opus. Prompt caching, batch discounts (typically 50% off), and tiered long-context pricing are now standard across major vendors. The research data references newer model generations (GPT-6, Claude 5.x, Gemini 4), but this table restricts itself to the confirmed, publicly available models with published pricing requested, verified against official vendor documentation.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Rate limits scale with usage tier.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost model for high-volume tasks. Batch API 50% discount available. Cached input at half price.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching writes cost more (5-min/1-hr TTL options); cache reads heavily discounted. Batch API 50% discount. Long-context pricing cliff applies above 200K.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available but Google may use free-tier content to improve products. Batch requests half price. Pricing varies by modality.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Higher input/output rate tier applies above 200K tokens ($2.50/$15.00). Batch requests half price. Free tier content may be used for product improvement.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens which are billed. Batch API 50% discount. Cached input at quarter of input price.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Reasoning model; reasoning tokens billed as output. Price reduced significantly in 2025. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest, lowest-cost Claude model. Prompt caching and batch (50% off) supported. Cache reads at one-tenth input price.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship high-end model. Prompt caching (5-min/1-hr) and batch 50% discount available. Premium pricing for complex reasoning tasks.

models.name: Grok (grok-beta / Grok 4)
models.notes: Pricing varies by Grok tier; cached input discounted. Live search and tool use billed separately. Rate limits by account tier.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (hosted)
models.notes: Open-weight model; price shown is Together AI hosted rate (same in/out). Also available on Groq and Fireworks at differing rates. Free trial credits offered.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Groq offers ultra-low-latency inference via LPU hardware. Free tier with rate limits available for developers.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Flagship Mistral model. La Plateforme offers free experimentation tier with rate limits. Batch API available at discount.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Cost-efficient model for lightweight tasks. Free tier available on La Plateforme. Batch discounts offered.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys with rate limits available; production keys billed per token.
